title: 第4章 朋友
novel_title: 县城：女友出国要我卖房，给脸了
content_zh:
晚上。

    父母接了小妹才回家的。

    李西海亲自动手，弄了一桌子的丰盛晚餐。

    他会做厨艺，但有条件是不会下厨的。

    “哟，今天太阳打西边出来咯。”

    小妹李西洛打趣，书包都还没丢下，俯身在桌子上嗅了嗅，“好香啊。”

    “哥，你难得下厨啊。”

    李父也有点诧异。

    他倒是知道儿子厨艺不错，年少时候很勤快的，动手能力也很强。

    只是大了，就贪图安逸，能图省事的绝对不麻烦自己。

    “大娃手艺没回潮啊。”

    李母也夸赞道。

    家庭氛围就是这样，不管饭菜如何，先表扬了再说。

    “吃饭，吃饭。”

    李西海吆喝道。

    李父坐下来吃了几口，突然开口问道：“今天很高兴？”

    “嗯。”

    李西海点头，顺手掏出手机，递了过去。

    人要懂事。

    父母这么支持他，自己就该有坦率的表示。

    这样才能让支持他的父母心安。

    李父拿起手机一看，动作顿时僵硬了。

    手机显示的正是投资账户信息。

    “十万？”

    李父不无惊声说道，还是震惊的看向李西海。

    “什么十万？”

    李母惊讶的问道，俯身过去一看，有点没太看懂。

    她是不太了解炒股的。

    “你儿子今天炒股盈利十万！”

    李父一字一顿的说道，语气带着激动还有极大的意外。

    他真不太敢相信。

    儿子一天操作，就有十万盈利。

    “哇。”

    “哥，你怎么这么残暴。”

    李西洛惊呼道：“相当于老爸老妈一年收入的五分之一了。”

    李母再三确认，让女儿告诉她到底怎么回事。

    李父点击账户，反复确认，这不是模拟软件，儿子没有欺骗他。

    心里长舒了一口气。

    一股喜悦油然而生。

    “怪不得你今天厨兴大发，原来是在这里等着啊。”

    李父很多时候喜怒不形于色，他一般不会直白夸李西海，倒不是他吝啬。

    而是只要李母夸了，他就会不说话。

    “大娃，有眼光啊。”

    “哈哈，实力，基操勿六！”
content_en:
night.

    My parents picked up my little sister before going home.

    Li Xihai took matters into his own hands and prepared a table of sumptuous dinner.

    He can cook, but there are conditions where he can't cook.

    "Hey, the sun is coming out in the west today."

    Younger sister Li Xiluo joked, before leaving her schoolbag, she leaned over the table and sniffed, "It smells so good."

    "Brother, it's rare for you to cook."

    Father Li was also a little surprised.

    He did know that his son was good at cooking. He was very diligent when he was young and had strong hands-on skills.

    It's just that when you get older, you will covet comfort, and those who can save trouble will never bother themselves.

    "Dawa's craftsmanship has not come back."

    Mother Li also praised.

    The family atmosphere is like this. No matter how the food is, praise it first.

    "Eat, eat."

    Li Xihai yelled.

    Father Li sat down and took a few bites, then suddenly asked, "Are you happy today?"

    "Yeah."

    Li Xihai nodded, took out his cell phone and handed it over.

    People should be sensible.

    If his parents support him so much, he should be candid about it.

    Only in this way can his parents who support him feel at ease.

    Father Li picked up the phone and looked at it, and his movements suddenly stiffened.

    What the phone displays is the investment account information.

    "One hundred thousand?"

    Li's father said in shock, but still looked at Li Xihai in shock.

    "What one hundred thousand?"

    Mother Li asked in surprise, leaning over to take a look, but she didn't quite understand.

    She doesn't know much about stock trading.

    "Your son made a profit of 100,000 from stock trading today!"

    Father Li said word by word, with excitement and great surprise in his tone.

    He couldn't believe it.

    My son made a profit of 100,000 yuan in one day's operation.

    "Wow."

    "Brother, why are you so cruel?"

    Li Xiluo exclaimed: “It’s equivalent to one-fifth of my parents’ annual income.”

    Mother Li confirmed again and again and asked her daughter to tell her what was going on.

    Father Li clicked on the account and repeatedly confirmed that this was not a simulation software and that his son had not deceived him.

    I breathed a sigh of relief.

    A burst of joy arises spontaneously.

    "No wonder you're so excited about cooking today. It turns out you're waiting here."

    Li's father often expresses his emotions and anger. He usually doesn't praise Li Xihai directly. It's not that he is stingy.

    But as long as Mother Li praised her, he would remain silent.

    "Big boy, you have a good vision."

    "Haha, strength, basic skills, don't do it six!"
